code='''from collections import deque, Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    seen = set()\n    q = deque()\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in (0, w - 1):\n            if grid[r][c] == bg and (r,c) not in seen:\n                seen.add((r,c)); q.append((r,c))\n    for c in range(w):\n        for r in (0, h - 1):\n            if grid[r][c] == bg and (r,c) not in seen:\n                seen.add((r,c)); q.append((r,c))\n    while q:\n        r,c=q.popleft()\n        for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):\n            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:\n                seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))\n    return [[4 if grid[r][c] == bg and (r,c) not in seen else grid[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]\n'''
